en: This is a sepia-toned postcard depicting a vintage office interior. Several men in suits are seated at roll-top desks, working with papers and typewriters. Books, papers, and a 'FOR SALE' sign are visible, along with office furniture of the early 20th century style. There is an electric light bulb hanging from the ceiling. Printed text provides the business name, Potvin-Pittock Company, Limited, and mentions they deal in real estate, loans, and insurance. Additional handwritten numbers and notes appear at the top right corner of the postcard.
